lines.（あ、花壇の世話……遅くなったし、今日はもう帰るか）:
(Oh, the flowerbeds... It's
late now, so I might as well
head home for today.)

lines.じゃあ。▲月▲▲日▲からの１泊２日で！:

starting on ▲月▲ ▲日▲！

lines.そういえばそうだ。さすがに眠くなってきた？:
Come to think of it, you're
right. Are you getting sleepy
by now？
lines.突然呼び出してごめん。これ、渡そうと思ってさ。:
Sorry for calling you out of
the blue. I wanted to give you
this.

lines.たまにしか来ないな: I only come once in a while.
lines.嫌いかな: I guess I don't like it.

lines.明日は月曜、また一週間がんばるか！:
Tomorrow's Monday. Guess I'll
do my best again this week！

lines.ここ、人目につかなそうな場所もあったんだな。ここなら彼女と二人きりになれるかも…:
There are some secluded spots
here too, huh. I might be able
to get time alone with my
girlfriend here...
lines.新作出てたんだな、知らなかった。来て良かったな！:
So a new one came out. I had
no idea. Glad I came！
lines.特に何もなかったな、無駄足だったかも。:
Nothing special here. Might've
been a wasted trip.
lines.視聴したやつ、全部ハズレだ……。:
Everything I tried out was a
dud...
lines.試聴したやつ、全部ハズレだ……。:
Everything I sampled was a
dud...

lines.（どうしよう。また▲彼女＊＊▲と行けるかな……）:
(What should I do...
Could I go with
▲彼女＊＊▲ again...)

lines.（クラスで喫茶店……まずはどんなメニューを出すか決めないとな）:
(A class cafe... First I need
to decide what to put on the
menu.)
lines.（クラスで喫茶店……接客の仕方を決めて、あとは当日のシフト組みかな）:
(Class cafe... I need to
decide how to serve customers,
then work out the shifts for
the day, I guess.)
lines.（図書委員で紙芝居……とにかく絵を描いて、物を用意しないと）:
(Picture-story show for the
library committee... Either
way, I have to draw the
pictures and prepare things.)
lines.（図書委員で紙芝居……まずは題材をどうするか決めないとな）:
(A picture-story show for the
library committee... First I
need to decide on a subject.)
lines.（図書委員で紙芝居……各自の作業分担を決めないとな）:
(Picture-story show for the
library committee... We need
to decide who does what.)
lines.（模擬店で焼きそば……まずは、焼きそばそのものをどんな味にするか決めないとな）:
(A yakisoba stall... First I
need to decide what flavor the
yakisoba should be.)
lines.（模擬店で焼きそば……屋台の準備をしないと）:
(Yakisoba stall... I need to
get the stall set up.)
lines.（模擬店で焼きそば……調理器具や食器類も用意しないとな）:
(Yakisoba stall... I need to
get cookware and dishes ready
too.)

lines.ここ、人目につかなそうな場所もあったんだな。ここなら彼女と二人きりになれるかも…:
There are some secluded spots
here too, huh. I might be able
to get time alone with my
girlfriend here...
lines.この店にいると、つい色々買っちゃうんだよな……無駄なものも……。:
Whenever I'm in this store, I
end up buying all kinds of
things... even useless ones...
lines.もうすぐ海開きか……このあたりもゴミゴミするんだろうな。:
The beach opens soon, huh...
This area's going to get
crowded and messy, I bet.
lines.もうすぐ海開きか……海水浴、楽しみだな！:
The beach opens soon, huh... I
can't wait to go swimming！
lines.ブラブラ見て回っただけだけど、結構楽しかったな。:
I just wandered around, but it
was pretty fun.
lines.面白そうなものもなかったし……無駄に時間過ごしちゃったかもな。:
Nothing looked interesting...
I might've just wasted my
time.

lines.ん～……明日が終われば週末だ！:
Hmm... Once tomorrow's over,
it's the weekend！
lines.明日は土曜。さて、なにしよっかな。:
Tomorrow's Saturday. Now, what
should I do？
lines.明日は月曜。また一週間がんばろう！:
Tomorrow's Monday. I'll do my
best again this week！
